The tumor involves the temporal lobe and cortex, which is common in both IDH-mutant and wildtype tumors. Overall, the young age and nonenhancing nature support IDH-mutant, but the low T2-FLAIR mismatch score contradicts it.

The temporal location favors astrocytoma over oligodendroglioma. Grade 2 is assigned due to absence of necrosis, enhancement, and high mitotic activity.
